name: Web Element Repositories
summary: Curated catalog of 225+ websites for HTML, CSS, JS and UI components, icons, buttons and color tools.
description: A link catalog of websites where you can find HTML, CSS and JS building blocks. Sections cover copy-paste component libraries, UI galleries and inspiration, button collections, icon repositories, color and gradient tools, loading spinners and CSS animations, Tailwind-specific libraries, code snippets, layout and grid tools, form components, typography, accessibility, template galleries, niche generators, image and lightbox tools, web component libraries, animation libraries and chart libraries. Each row lists the site with a short description and a pricing note.
contains: sections: component libraries, UI galleries, buttons, icons, color tools, spinners, Tailwind, snippets
more sections: layout, form components, typography, accessibility, templates, generators, charts
each entry tagged 'Fully free', 'Mostly free with few paid' or 'Paid with free'
